items.title: Barry Harris — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I went out with Ruth Brown, and we played shows and we played for shake dances.

ctx.x: Gary, Indiana. I got in the Union through a guitar player named Emmitt Slay. He was doing a show opposite Mantan Moreland in Cleveland, so I got in the union and went
to Cleveland. I went out with Ruth Brown, and we played shows and we played for shake dances.
